app.name: FITD Wii Teste 06.3
app.short_description: Native Wii GX: safe BODY rest pose and pixel-sharp occlusion masks
app.long_description: Experimental native PowerPC/GX technical prototype. Restores articulated BODY pose without an animation, scans original LISTANIM.PAK for skeleton-compatible clips and permits manual B+A inspection. Uses nearest-sampled, alpha-tested foreground masks to reduce black outlines. Not a complete playable game; user-owned original PAK files required and not bundled. Test06.1 remains the approved reference.
